prompt: Read this class's own .java file at run time and report the @param names documented for a given method. Complete OwnSourceDocReader and run the tests.
explanation: A program can read its own source the same way it reads any other text file, because Files.readString only needs a path relative to the working directory. From there the task is line scanning: locate the declaration, walk upwards past blank lines to the comment that ends just above it, and check that the comment was opened with the doc marker rather than a plain one. One of the tests asks about documentedParamsOf itself, so a hard-coded answer will not survive -- the method really has to parse the file.
hints: java.nio.file.Files.readString(java.nio.file.Path.of(SOURCE_FILE)) gives you the whole file; split it with split("\n", -1) so line numbers line up.
Search for a line that starts with a modifier and contains methodName + "(" -- that avoids matching calls and comment text.
Walking up from the declaration: skip blank lines, require the next line to end with the comment closer, then keep going until a line starts with "/**" (give up if you meet a plain "/*" first).
